All of one deployment's auth state sits in a single AuthRoom, so sign-in and token write throughput is one Durable Object's. Not measured for auth traffic yet.

architecture.summary: Not a port. A compatible OIDC provider on Workers using Better Auth and its OAuth 2.1 provider plugin, storing everything in TapeDB's AuthRoom, with realms modelled as separate deployments or as an explicit tenant key. SAML, federation and custom flows stay out of scope unless an application needs them.

risks.description: Multi-step Better Auth flows can leave partial writes on failure.
risks.mitigation: Identify each flow in runWithTransaction (AUTH-COMPATIBILITY.md) and add reconciliation or idempotent retry in the application.

risks.description: One AuthRoom serves every sign-in and token refresh of a deployment.
risks.mitigation: Benchmark auth write throughput before launch; shard by deployment (realm) if it does not hold.

risks.description: An identity provider is a high-value target and no parity is claimed.
risks.mitigation: Conformance suite plus an independent security review are release gates.

costAssumptions.assumption: Each sign-in and token refresh is one or more AuthRoom calls; volumes not modelled yet.

decisions.title: Rewrite a compatible OIDC provider rather than port Keycloak
decisions.context: Keycloak is a Quarkus/JVM server with JPA and Infinispan; none of it runs in Workers.

options.name: Port Keycloak
options.tradeoffs: No JVM in Workers; would need containers, which is a VPS by another name.

options.name: Compatible rewrite on Better Auth and TapeDB
options.tradeoffs: Reuses verified primitives (sessions, MFA, OAuth provider); drops SAML, federation and configurable flows; no parity.

options.name: Use an external IdP
options.tradeoffs: Least work and full protocol coverage; not serverless-on-Cloudflare.

decisions.choice: Compatible rewrite on Better Auth and TapeDB
decisions.consequences: The OIDC subset an application needs is covered and tested; SAML, LDAP and custom flows are external or excluded.
